literal_meaning: নামের সংকীর্তন (চanting of the divine name)
figurative_meaning_en: Devotional chanting or praise of God's name
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি প্রতিদিন নামসংকীর্তন করে মনের শান্তি পান।
গ্রামে নামসংকীর্তনের আসরে সবাই যোগ দেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He finds peace of mind by engaging in devotional chanting every day.
Everyone joins the gathering for praise of God's name in the village.
history: Rooted in the 16th-century Bhakti movement led by Chaitanya Mahaprabhu in Bengal, where congregational chanting of Krishna's name became a central practice.
note: This expression is more of a religious practice than a secular idiom, deeply embedded in Vaishnava traditions.
